s.g: (archaic or dialectal, Scotland) The name of the Latin script letter J/j.
A bird, the wryneck, once thought a bird of ill omen (Jynx torquilla).
One of an order of spiritual intelligences in ancient “Chaldaic” philosophy.
(Hinduism) A shrine where Lord Shiva is worshipped in the form of a Jyotirlingam or "Lingam (pillar) of light."
